prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Make a square nine-panel 3-by-3 sprite sheet for the standard BURPEE (squat-thrust, push-up and overhead jump) featuring one anatomically consistent adult male Gym Stone anime fitness guide. Reference image is appearance/style only: same face, hairstyle, red athletic tank, dark shorts, red trainers, layered clean cel shading with fine anatomical and fabric details. Each panel is exactly one equal square in the regular 3×3 grid. All nine panels use EXACT SAME orthographic right-facing SIDE PROFILE with a very small front angle (just enough to see two hands and two feet). The body never turns toward the viewer. Keep fixed magnification, head and body proportions, same lighting, white background. The level top line of a thin, long charcoal gym mat at 81% down each panel runs from x8% to x92% in EXACTLY the same location and perspective in all nine, so both the floor and body contact can be compared. Each panel is one full-body pose with generous space above the jump and around every edge. Subject faces screen right in every pose. The standing position is near the right half (feet x~58%). Hands land near x69% and stay on exactly that point from the squat through plank, push-up and return. Rear feet in plank near x23%. Clearly separate two arms and legs anatomically as viewed in this fixed side profile. No cropping, labels, numbers, arrows, panel outlines or any markings. Sequence exactly left-to-right, top-to-bottom:
TOP LEFT 1, upright neutral standing at x58%, arms relaxed at sides and both shoes flat on mat. TOP CENTER 2, a deep squat with both feet flat under the hips near x54%, hands planted on the mat to their right near x69%, preparing to jump back. TOP RIGHT 3, high plank with arms straight, wrists on exactly that x69% point under shoulders, neck to heels a nearly straight sloping line, both legs straight back and both toes at x23%. MIDDLE LEFT 4, bottom of a controlled push-up with both elbows visibly bent close to the body, chest a little above mat, both palms and both toes at the identical spots as panel 3, knees straight off the mat. MIDDLE CENTER 5, high plank again with straight arms and same hands and toes, clear line from neck to heels. MIDDLE RIGHT 6, hands STILL planted at x69%; simultaneous hop forward with BOTH feet airborne a few inches above the mat, both knees bent and clearly traveling forward toward chest, hips lift, head still faces right. BOTTOM LEFT 7, BOTH feet have landed together under hips at x54%, hands still planted just ahead, both knees bent in a deep squat. BOTTOM CENTER 8, the apex of a small VERTICAL jump, torso upright at x58%, both straight arms reach overhead, BOTH feet clearly off the mat with white air gap and a subtle shadow; the mat stays unchanged, entire hands and shoes visible. BOTTOM RIGHT 9, softly landing with both shoes planted flat at x58%, hips and knees modestly bent, hands returning down, ready to stand again. Do not create visual duplicates with extra limbs. Feet do not travel in the overhead jump. Every pose on the same single mat aligned to the same baseline and never change camera or perspective.
